انجذبت (form VII)
# اِنْجَذَبْتُ (injaḏabtu) /in.d͡ʒa.ðab.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِنْجَذَبَ (injaḏaba)
# اِنْجَذَبْتَ (injaḏabta) /in.d͡ʒa.ðab.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِنْجَذَبَ (injaḏaba)
# اِنْجَذَبْتِ (injaḏabti) /in.d͡ʒa.ðab.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِنْجَذَبَ (injaḏaba)
# اِنْجَذَبَتْ (injaḏabat) /in.d͡ʒa.ða.bat/: thir
